questions.question: Sai can do a piece of work alone in 50 days. Ria is 25% more efficient than Sai. What is the number of days that Ria will take to do the same piece of work alone?
questions.solution:
Given:

Sai can do a piece of work alone in 50 days. Ria is 25% more efficient than Sai.

Concept used:

1. Efficiency (work done per day) of workers is inversely proportional to the time taken by workers to complete a particular task.

2. Incremented/Reduced value = Initial value (1 ± change%)

Calculation:

Time taken by Ria to complete the work = 50 ÷ (1 + 25%) = 40 days

∴ Ria will take 40 days to do the same piece of work alone.

questions.question: If 30% of a number is 15 more than 135, find 50% of that number.
questions.solution:
Given: 

30% of a number is 15 more than 135.

Calculation:

Let the number be N.

According to the question,

30% of N = 135 + 15

⇒ 0.3N = 150

⇒ N = 150/0.3

⇒ N = 500

⇒ N × 50% = 500 × 50%

⇒ N × 50% = 250

**∴ 50% of that number equals 250.**

questions.question: If the cost price of an item is ₹2,000 and it is sold at a loss of 25%, then find its selling price.
questions.solution:

The cost price of an item is ₹2,000 and it is sold at a loss of 25%.

questions.question: A person marks the price of his car 50% above the cost price. He gives a discount of B% and earns a profit of 10%. What is the approximate value of B?
questions.solution:

A person marks the price of his car 50% above the cost price. 

He gives a discount of B% and earns a profit of 10%.

Concept used:

Final percentage change after two successive increments of A% and B% = (A + B + {AB over 100})\%

Calculation:

According to the concept,

50 - B - (50B)/100 = 10 (Here, B% discount is considered as a negative mark-up/increment)

⇒ 50 - B - B/2 = 10

⇒ 3B/2 = 40

⇒ B = 80/3

⇒ B ≈ 26.67

∴ The approximate value of B is 26.67.

questions.question: The ratio of the speed of a bus to that of a train is 15 ∶ 27. Also, a car covers a distance of 720 km in 9 hours. The speed of the bus is three-fourths of the speed of the car. How much distance will the train cover in 7 hours?
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of the speed of a bus to that of a train is 15 ∶ 27. 

Also, a car covers a distance of 720 km in 9 hours. 

The speed of the bus is three-fourths of the speed of the car. 

Concept used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Speed of the car = 720/9 = 80 km/h

So, speed of the bus = 3/4 × 80 = 60 km/h

So, speed of the train = 27 × (60 ÷ 15) = 108 km/h

Now, the distance that the train will cover in 7 hours = 108 × 7 = 756 km

∴ The train will cover 756 km.

questions.question: The average of 47 consecutive natural numbers is 99. What is the largest number among these numbers?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of 47 consecutive natural numbers is 99.

Concept used:

A, (A + D), (A + 2D), ....., L is an arithmetic progression with the first term, common difference, and last term A, D, and L respectively.

Sum of the series = (A + L)/2 × N (N = number of terms in the series)

Nth term of the series = A + (N - 1) × D

Calculation:

Let the first number be N.

Since the numbers are consecutive, the common difference is 1 with N being the first term in the arithmetic progression.

So, 47th term = N + (47 - 1) × 1 = N + 46

According to the concept,

{N + (N + 46)}/2 × 47 = 99 × 47

⇒ {N + (N + 46)}/2 = 99

⇒ 2N + 46 = 198

⇒ N = (198 - 46)/2

⇒ N = 76

So, 47th term = 76 + 46 = 122

∴ The largest number is 122.

questions.question: A sum of ₹15,250 is divided among Shrinza, Sheetal and Chirag such that Shrinza receives 40% more than Sheetal and Sheetal receives 40% less than Chirag. What is Chirag's share?
questions.solution:
Given:

A sum of ₹15,250 is divided among Shrinza, Sheetal, and Chirag such that Shrinza receives 40% more than Sheetal and Sheetal receives 40% less than Chirag.

Calculation:

Let's suppose, Chirag receives Rs. x.

Sheetal receives = x(1 - 40%) = Rs. 0.6x

Shrinza receives = 0.6x(1 + 40%) = Rs. 0.84x

According to the question,

x + 0.6x + 0.84x = 15250

⇒ 2.44x = 15250

⇒ x = 15250/2.44

⇒ x = 6250

∴ Chirag's share is Rs. 6250.

questions.question: The ratio between the volumes of Sphere 1 and Sphere 2 is 27 ∶ 64. Find the ratio of the surface areas of Sphere 1 and Sphere 2.
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio between the volumes of Sphere 1 and Sphere 2 is 27 ∶ 64.

Concept used:

1. Volume of a sphere = {4pi R³ over 3} (R is the radius of the sphere)

2. The curved surface of a sphere = 4πR2 (R is the radius of the sphere)

Calculation:

Let the radii of sphere 1 and sphere 2 be r and R respectively.

According to the concept,

4πr³/3 : 4πR3/3 = 27 : 64

⇒ r : R = sqrt[3]{27} : sqrt[3]{64}

⇒ r : R = 3 : 4

So, the radii of sphere 1 and sphere 2 are 3k and 4k respectively. (k = constant)

Now, the ratio of the surface areas of sphere 1 and sphere 2

⇒ 4π × (3k)² : 4π × (4k)2

⇒ 9 : 16

**∴ The ratio of the surface areas of sphere 1 and sphere 2 is 9 : 16.**

questions.question: The product of the LCM and the HCF of two numbers is 216. The difference between the two numbers is 6. What are the numbers?
questions.solution:
Given:

The product of the LCM and the HCF of two numbers is 216. 

The difference between the two numbers is 6.

Concept used:

1. LCM × HCF = The Product of two numbers

2. (A - B)2 = (A + B)2 - 4AB

Calculation:

Let the two numbers be A and B.

According to the concept,

AB = 216 ....(1)

According to the question,

(A - B) = 6 ....(2)

⇒ (A - B)² = 6²

⇒ (A + B)² - 4AB = 36

⇒ (A + B)² - 4 × 216 = 36

⇒ (A + B)2 = 900

⇒ (A + B) = 30 ....(3)

Solving (2) and (3), A = 18, B = 12

∴ The two numbers are 18 and 12.

questions.question: X and Y are two alloys of copper and aluminium prepared by mixing the metals in the ratio 6 ∶ 5 and 5 ∶ 9, respectively. If equal quantities of the alloys are melted to form a third alloy Z, what ratio of copper and aluminium will be in Z?
questions.solution:
Given:

X and Y are two alloys of copper and aluminium prepared by mixing the metals in the ratio 6 ∶ 5 and 5 ∶ 9, respectively. 

Equal quantities of the alloys are melted to form a third alloy Z.

Calculation:

Let's suppose, k units of each alloy were taken together.

The total quantity of cooper in alloy Z

⇒ Total quantity of cooper in k units of alloy X + Total quantity of cooper in k units of alloy Y

⇒ (6/(6 + 5) × k + 5/(5 + 9) × k)

The total quantity of aluminium in alloy Z

⇒ Total quantity of aluminium in k units of alloy X + Total quantity of aluminium in k units of alloy Y

⇒ (5/(6 + 5) × k + 9/(5 + 9) × k)

Now, the ratio of copper and aluminium will be in Z

⇒ (6/(6 + 5) × k + 5/(5 + 9) × k) : (5/(6 + 5) × k + 9/(5 + 9) × k)

⇒ (6/11 + 5/14) : (5/11 + 9/14)

⇒ 139/154 : 169/154

⇒ 139 ∶ 169

**∴ The ratio of copper and aluminium will be 139 ∶ 169 in Z.**

Curved surface area = πrl (where r = radius of the base and l = slant height)

questions.question: The ratio of the speeds of two scooters is 9 ∶ 5. If the second scooter runs 75 km in 6 hours, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the first scooter?
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of the speeds of two scooters is 9 ∶ 5.

The second scooter runs 75 km in 6 hours.

Concept used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Speed of the second scooter = 75/6 = 25/2 km/h

Now, the speed of the first scooter = 9 × (25/2 ÷ 5) = 22.5 km/h

∴ The speed of the first scooter is 22.5 km.
